info.title: Hierarchical Financial Multi-Agent Analysis API
info.description: Reference API for analysis of Vietnamese listed banks. The contract preserves single-period provider-backed company/peer analysis and adds a bounded Company-only trend shape with deterministic acceptance and bounded semantic review. Multi-period peer/macro scope remains unsupported.

get.description: Returns operational liveness status of the API service.
Validates database connectivity and analytical readiness.

post.description: Freezes a query-derived plan before retrieval, invokes only required provider-declared capabilities, synthesizes canonical claims, runs Stage-1, then configured semantic critique and at most two targeted revision rounds. Unsupported scope or unavailable configuration fails closed. Offline tests do not establish live provider readiness.

AnalysisRequest.description: Period normalization: period only becomes [period]; periods only uses its final item as the anchor; both require period == periods[-1]; neither is allowed only when exactly one canonical period can be resolved from query. A multi-period query requires explicit periods and any periods/range stated in query must match it exactly. All conflicts fail before provider or model calls.

query.description: Natural language analytical question in Vietnamese or English
query.example: Phân tích ACB tại 2024_Q4 dựa trên ROE và NPL.

target_ticker.description: Primary bank ticker symbol under investigation

peer_tickers.description: Optional list of peer comparison bank tickers

period.description: Legacy single-period selector, or the final/anchor period when periods is also supplied. When both fields are present, this value must equal the last item of periods.

periods.description: Exact canonical period scope in strictly increasing chronological order. One item is equivalent to a single-period request. Two to four items select the bounded Company-only trend path; peer or macro multi-period scope remains unsupported. The list must match every explicit period or expanded range in query.

upload_id.description: Optional uploaded dataset identifier for user-supplied bank analysis

example.query: So sánh ROE và NPL của ACB với MBB, TCB, VCB và VPB tại 2024_Q4.

period.description: Final/anchor period. It equals the last item of periods.

periods.description: Frozen ordered period scope used by every specialist, claim, synthesis/revision round, event and persisted report.

interest_rate_trend.example: Accommodative monetary policy by SBV supporting private credit recovery

peer_median_roa.description: Accepted peer median in percentage units, only when requested and supported.

peer_median_npl_g35.description: Accepted peer median for bank.npl_g35; exact current metric suffix. peer_median_npl is retained as a legacy alias.

aggregation_method.description: Versioned provider aggregation method; currently peer_median_v1.

requested_peer_entity_ids.description: Ordered requested member set defining benchmark identity and claim scope.

eligible_peer_entity_ids.description: Ordered members supplying accepted numeric input observations.

eligible_denominator.description: Number of accepted numeric member inputs used by the aggregate.

missing_members.description: Requested members excluded from the numeric denominator, each with an explicit reason.

benchmarks.description: Authoritative per-metric benchmark records for new peer reports. Shared legacy metadata is emitted only when identical across all records.

SectorBenchmark.description: Peer medians for the explicitly requested case-study set. New provider-backed reports populate benchmarks with metadata per metric. Legacy scalar medians remain for compatibility; shared top-level metadata must be omitted when membership or denominator differs across records. Older saved reports may omit these additive fields.

metric_period_records.description: Company trend responses with 2–4 frozen periods populate authoritative metric-by-period facts ordered first by AnalysisPlan.periods and then by requested metric order. Single-period responses may omit or return an empty array to preserve the legacy scalar format. Multi-period reports must not collapse repeated metrics into legacy scalar fields.

CompanyMetricPeriodRecord.description: One Company fact or explicit missing cell for one metric and one period. The valid and missing states are mutually exclusive.

scope_status.description: For a valid record, verified requires a non-empty reporting_scope; unavailable requires reporting_scope=null and an explicit AnalysisResponse limitation. Unknown scope never supports peer comparison. Missing cells use null.

finding.example: ACB preserved retail asset quality despite elevated consumer delinquency across tier-2 peers.

observation_id.description: Canonical observation asserted by this numeric claim.

input_observation_ids.description: Accepted input observations for a derived numeric claim.

formula_version.description: Versioned formula for a derived numeric claim.

claim_id.description: Claim supported by this source record; derived claims may have one row per input observation.

observation_id.description: Exact canonical observation whose primary source and locator are shown.

source_id.description: Primary source record ID resolved from the observation.

source_url.description: Original document URL when the reviewed source supplies one.

source_doc.example: Bao cao tai chinh hop nhat kiem toan 2024

table_locator.example: Bao cao ket qua hoat dong kinh doanh

reason.example: Do tre truyen dan lai suat huy dong sang NIM can bo sung thuyet minh BCTC quy 4.

synthesis_revised.description: True only when a bounded revision changed the typed report-level synthesis artifact. It does not mark unchanged claims as revised.

synthesis_summary.description: Grounded qualitative synthesis of the active specialist artifacts. New runtime responses populate this field; numeric facts remain in canonical claims and benchmark records.

synthesis_supporting_claim_ids.description: Unique final claim IDs, in candidate order, that support the exact synthesis artifact reviewed by the critic.

PeerBenchmarkRecord.description: One accepted provider benchmark for one metric and period. Its requested/eligible sets and missing-member reasons apply only to this record, never to other metrics in the report.

requested_peer_entity_ids.description: Ordered requested member set defining benchmark identity and claim scope.

eligible_peer_entity_ids.description: Ordered members supplying accepted numeric input observations.

aggregation_method.description: Versioned provider aggregation method; currently peer_median_v1.

eligible_denominator.description: Number of accepted numeric member inputs used by the aggregate.

missing_members.description: Requested members excluded from the numeric denominator, each with an explicit reason.
